title: Build your first data pipeline
objectives: Find every data quality problem with queries you can run again
Decide what each problem means for the answer
Build a clean, checked result from raw data

exercises.prompt: List every problem row, one row per problem, as table_name and key.
hints: There are six problems: three in customers and three in orders. The starter finds one.
In customers: a row loaded twice, a missing email, a region spelled differently. In orders: a negative amount, a date in the future, a store that doesn't exist.
Combine one query per problem with UNION ALL. GROUP BY customer_id HAVING count(*) > 1 finds the duplicate.

exercises.prompt: Show the ten customers with the most revenue from complete orders, leaving out the bad rows: customer_id, orders, revenue, largest first, customer_id breaking ties.
hints: Only orders with status 'complete' are revenue.
Leave out the three bad orders you found: a negative amount, a future date and an unknown store.
ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_id makes ties come out the same way every time.
